Gradient of normal $=-\frac13$, so gradient of tangent $=3$ — B1 B1 FT

$\frac{dy}{dx}=2x-5=3$ — M1

Differentiate and set equal to tangent gradient.

$x=4$ — *A1

Use $(4,7)$ on the normal and substitute in the curve — DM1

Any valid method deriving a linear equation in $k$.

$k=11$ — A1
